name: aim
description: Messages between AI coding sessions across tools, accounts and companies. A question from another person's session wakes this one; the answer goes back the same way. Access is approved by a human on the AIM website, never by a model.

relay_url.title: Relay address
relay_url.description: The AIM relay to sign in to. Leave it as it is unless you run your own.

uvx_path.title: uvx command
uvx_path.description: How to start uvx. Change it to an absolute path, such as /usr/local/bin/uvx, when Claude Code reports the server as failed because it cannot find uvx on its PATH.
